닫히다.n: everyday — a door, window, or lid closes, no official action
cf: to be closed; to be blocked; to be shut down
passive — a place or road is officially closed or sealed
to close down; to seal off
formal, facility or place shut down or sealed off

알아듣다.e: to understand (what you hear), to catch
cf: to catch; to get; to comprehend
to grasp meaning; casual, mostly in negatives
